'''Kor Bareesh''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the ruined [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Bareesh]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].

==History==
Kor Bareesh was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Bareesh]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], a formerly powerful [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. However, at some point, Kor Bareesh was devastated by the eruption of a massive [[Volcano/Legends|supervolcano]], which covered much of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] main continent with ash and [[Magma/Legends|lava]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The eruption buried or destroyed the clan's vaults, and also killed a number of influential clan leaders. The Bareesh still retained their ancient holdings on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], but enemy clans took advantage of the chaos to take control of their operations and holdings elsewhere. As a result, the Hutts of Bareesh saw their strength greatly diminish over the next [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] and struggled to remain profitable.<ref name="LoNH" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Tragtath]] the Hutt led regular expeditions to recover lost artifacts and treasures in the buried vaults of Kor Bareesh. These expeditions were manned by hundreds of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and hired experts. However, most of them failed due to the harsh conditions on the ruined planet.<ref name="LoNH" />
